verdict.rationale: ClickUp's own docs say views can be created and filtered at any level of the hierarchy, so the product does save filtered views. The evidence describes this only through the API, and nothing shows sharing a view by link. Missing for 10: any evidence of sharing a view via a link (public or internal), UI-level documentation of saving filtered views, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can save a filtered view of work and share it with a link

citations.quote: You can create, update, delete, group, sort, and filter views at any level of the ClickUp hierarchy using the API.
